title: kb_mcp.py --register-local --backlog-write on|off registers the local kb server with the write tools served or not, beside the coord switch
goal: python3 _tools/kb_mcp.py --register-local --backlog-write on registers the local kb server with KB_BACKLOG_WRITE_TOOLS=1 in its env and off with none of it, a run with --coord-tools off too keeps both variables in the one registration, and --dry-run prints the claude mcp add-json command with the env without running it; kb_mcp.py --status names whether the registered server serves the write tools; plugin.md says the plugin's own kb server serves none of them (plugin.json sets no env) and how a host adds them

run: import subprocess,sys;p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"_tools/kb_mcp.py","--register-local","--backlog-write","on","--coord-tools","off","--dry-run"],capture_output=True,text=True);o=p.stdout+p.stderr;assert p.returncode==0,(p.returncode,o[-300:]);assert "KB_BACKLOG_WRITE_TOOLS" in o and "KB_COORD_TOOLS" in o,o[-400:];q=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"_tools/kb_mcp.py","--register-local","--backlog-write","off","--dry-run"],capture_output=True,text=True);assert q.returncode==0 and "KB_BACKLOG_WRITE_TOOLS" not in q.stdout,q.stdout[-300:]
